title: Nonadiabatic Dynamics and Rotational Coupling in $\mathrm{HeH^+}$ Dissociative Recombination and Resonant Ion-Pair Formation
summary: We present a time-dependent wave-packet study of dissociative recombination (DR) and resonant ion-pair (RIP) formation in $\mathrm{HeH^+}$ isotopologues. Nuclear dynamics are treated on a manifold of 23 coupled electronic states of $^2Σ$, $^2Π$, and $^2Δ$ symmetries, including rotational couplings between different symmetries. The results reveal that inclusion of a large manifold of resonant states and rotational couplings significantly enhances the DR cross section relative to earlier theoretical studies.
